changeSet.comment: Create ${adminRole} (NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS LOGIN) if absent, grant it the same nexus+staging DML/sequence access bootstrapServiceRole gives svcRole (it still needs to read/write ordinary rows through normal grants), then transfer OWNERSHIP of nexus.topic_assignments to it -- the one authority a plain DML role cannot get, and the one taxonomy-010/012's own ALTER TABLE ... NO FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY step actually requires.
